stem: There are 10 sunglasses in each display case at a store. Which table shows the number of sunglasses in different numbers of these display cases?

options.label: A
options.text:
Number of Display Cases  2  6  11  12
Number of Sunglasses  20  30  40  50

options.label: B
options.text:
Number of Display Cases  2  6  11  12
Number of Sunglasses  20  60  110  120

options.label: C
options.text:
Number of Display Cases  2  6  11  12
Number of Sunglasses  20  60  100  140

options.label: D
options.text:
Number of Display Cases  2  6  11  12
Number of Sunglasses  10  20  30  40

visual_elements: Four tables labeled A, B, C, and D each show 'Number of Display Cases' with values 2, 6, 11, 12 and corresponding 'Number of Sunglasses' values.
difficulty_rationale: Requires understanding of multiplication and checking for consistency across multiple values in the table.
